conditions.rationale: Lowest inducer dose, no inhibitor. Both experimental factors are condition-owned constants in the model and neither appears in the parameter table: u multiplies the KinA activation rate, bx11 switches the fixed BX-11 block on RegB activation. No pre-equilibration anywhere in this case: the description says the t=0 samples are uninduced cells harvested immediately before the inducer went in, with all three species at or near zero, so the model's declared initial state (Aa = Ba = D = 0) is the experimental starting state. Pre-equilibrating would replace it with a resting steady state the experiment did not have.
Reference dose, no inhibitor. u = 1 is the standard working stock the other two doses are expressed against.
Highest dose, no inhibitor. The description flags that dose linearity of KinA activation is untested above u = 4, so this condition is where a linear-in-dose activation term would first show strain.
Reference dose with BX-11. Same inducer as c_u1, so the pair isolates the inhibitor's effect at fixed drive — this is the comparison that says what ProD does when the RegB route is shut.

Highest dose with BX-11, the corner of the design where the inhibitor and the top dose meet. Encoded like any other condition; whether its measurements enter the fit is not this agent's call — the holdout is declared in the testcase at staging time and applied downstream, so this encoding is written the same way whether the condition is trained on or held out.
